newsitem.title: FINLAND: Niinisto says Moody's upgrade may boost confidence.
newsitem.headline: Niinisto says Moody's upgrade may boost confidence.

text.p: Finance Minister Sauli Niinisto said on Wednesday that U.S. credit rating agency Moody's upgrade of Finland's foreign currency debt to Aa1 from Aa2 was a positive surprise that may further boost confidence in Finland.
"The upgrade of our foreign currency debt was a positive surprise," Niinisto told Reuters by telephone.
He also said he was pleased with the assigned Aaa rating on markka-denominated debt, which put Finland's domestic rating one notch ahead of western neighbour Sweden.
"I think this can improve general confidence in Finland further," Niinisto said.

He said the upgrade of foreign currency debt will help reduce interest spending on the state debt as it is refinanced, and expected positive indirect effects from both the upgrade and the assignment of markka debt rating.
"It may also boost direct investment, maybe stock market investment and so on," Niinisto said.
